senses.gloss: (ברני) f. (Λιβυρνίς, sub. ναῦς) Liburnian (ship), a light fast-sailing vessel.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 33:21">Targ. Is. XXXIII, 21</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 77b">Yoma 77ᵇ</cite> (citation of Targ. l. c.).

B. Mets. 80ᵇ ג׳ כורין לב׳ וכ׳ an addition of three khor is a culpable overload for a large liburna. [Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵃ bot. בורניות, v. בִּרְיוֹן.] [Targ. Y. Gen. XXXVI, 2 בורנייתא some ed., v. כּוּדְנָא.]
